blocks.text: MARAWI CITY – Secretary Nasser Pangandaman Jr., Presidential Adviser for Marawi Rehabilitation and Development, led Saturday’s commemoration of this city’s liberation from the hands of Islamic State-linked militants nine years ago. Soldiers from the Army’s 103rd Infantry Brigade rendered a 21-gun salute for government security personnel who sacrificed their lives to liberate the city. October 17 is observed here as “Marawi Liberation Day” to mark the momentous occassion when government security forces completely flushed out the combined Abu Sayyaf and Maute Group bandits who laid a siege on the city on May 23, 2017.
